result.summary: Audit 1 passed slot a (E), slot b (N) and R group A (+0.61 head, 5 variants). Only R group B (head +1.22, soundness 2) failed, and it is the only part rewritten. The old dose-ladder variants still divided by a power of the volume level, so they were dropped. The 3 new variants replace the (sum Volume^3)^2 denominator with scale-free quantities, and the numerator becomes realized skewness, sum r^3 / (sum r^2)^1.5, because sum r^3 by itself is a convex function of volatility (trap 1). v1 is amount-weighted realized skewness: cross_mean(div(day_wmean(r^3, Amt), pow_1_5(day_wmean(r^2, Amt))), 20). v2 is realized skewness times the 60-day z-score of day_sum(Amt) against the stock's own history. Amt is used instead of Volume so bonus-share splits do not show up as abnormal volume, and the z-score is multiplied rather than dividing by relative volume, which would turn the signal into a locked-limit-day indicator. v3 combines v1 and v2. Plain realized skewness is not re-evaluated: it equals r1 slot b seed 6, which is not among the top 5 r1b scores (fifth is +0.38), so it scored below +0.38 and serves as the floor reference. Prediction: none reaches +1.32 (95%). R now has 8 variants in total (5 + 3).
